# Siddhant School of Yoga

> Siddhant School of Yoga is an officially registered Yoga Teacher Training school in Rishikesh, India, approved by Yoga Alliance USA (RYS 200, 300, 500). It offers authentic 100, 200, 300, and 500-hour Yoga Teacher Training courses, Kundalini Yoga TTC, and residential retreats, led personally by Acharya Siddhant.

Rishikesh sits where the Ganga meets the Himalayan foothills and is widely regarded as the world capital of yoga. Siddhant School of Yoga combines this traditional setting with a Pranayama-focused curriculum, small batch sizes, and a 100-day post-course practice schedule for graduates.

## Courses

- [Yoga Teacher Training (100h / 200h / 300h / 500h)](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#courses): Yoga Alliance USA registered teacher training programs in Hatha, Ashtanga, and Vedic philosophy.
- [Kundalini Yoga Teacher Training](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#kundalini): Chakra activation, sacred mantra resonance, and kundalini kriyas.
- [Yoga Retreats](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#retreats): 3 to 14-day retreats covering beginner yoga, meditation, kundalini, pranayama, vipassana, and Ayurvedic detox.

## School

- [About the School](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#about): Traditional yoga teacher training in Rishikesh, India.
- [Acharya Siddhant (Founder)](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#founder): Founder and spiritual director, master of Hatha, Ashtanga, and classical Pranayama.
- [Faculty & Teachers](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#teachers): Himalayan-trained masters teaching philosophy, anatomy, meditation, and asana.
- [Ashram & Residential Experience](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#residential): Accommodation, sattvic meals, and daily sadhana schedule.
- [Student Reviews](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#testimonials): Verified Google and TripAdvisor reviews from graduates in 60+ countries.
- [FAQ](https://siddhantschoolofyoga.com/#faq): Common questions about registration, visas, course fees, and what to expect.
